claims.asserted: The corpus contains three distinct realized forms of the effective response function: Gamma_A = rho/(rho+rho_crit), Gamma_B = rho^(3/2)/(rho+rho_crit), Gamma_C = sqrt(rho/rho_crit)/(1+sqrt(rho/rho_crit)).
The three Gamma forms do not form a linear maturation chain Gamma_A -> Gamma_B -> Gamma_C; they form a shape bifurcation with one declared-but-undemonstrated relation (B -> B+).

Gamma_B carries a residual dimension sqrt([rho]) and is not used as a common normalized response until a source-supplied prefactor or reference scale is specified; this dimensional inconsistency is present in source package 31942821.
The B -> B+ relation is a declared companion upgrade with supersession status 'not established'.
The bifurcation is described by two separate model-family axes (E-exponent axis, Gamma-shape axis), both open selections.
The square root appears in two distinct roles (E-axis exponent E ~ sqrt(g) versus Gamma-axis density dependence sqrt(rho/rho_crit)) that must not be conflated.

KC1 is an explicit conditional falsification criterion: if robust bias-controlled galaxy data demonstrate the linear form mu(g)=1/(exp(g/a0)-1) and significantly exclude the sqrt(g) form at >=5 sigma, then E ~ sqrt(g) is falsified.
KC1 provenance gap: the >=5 sigma SPARC claim's Delta_chi2 and significance are null and 'no new fit performed'; the provenance of that exclusion remains open and author-gated.
Discriminator 1 (SPARC/RAR retrodiction) is proposed and not executed; a0 is not author-frozen (candidates 1.2e-10, 6.5e-10, a0_eff = C^2 a0).
Discriminator 2 (GW/EM siren test dL^GW != dL^EM) is proposed and not executed; coupling parameters (alpha, phi0, phi(z)) are not frozen and the test is not EFC-specific until frozen.
No new fit is executed, no axis selection is made, and no independent validation of any package is claimed in this work.

Byte-for-byte reproducible PDF builds are an open workflow item, not an achieved property (pdfTeX embeds a wall-clock timestamp and a per-run trailer identifier unless explicitly suppressed); the current build completes with no Overfull or Underfull hbox warnings and no float-placement warnings.

MOND-like behaviour and LCDM-like behaviour are candidate effective regimes of a single underlying energy-flow framework: LCDM the global linear/screened L0/L1 special-case limit (corpus 31943361), MOND the local low-acceleration (IR) emergent response (corpus 31348411, read within the regime ontology 31348417).

The manuscript's corpus-provenance scope covers the six primary Gamma-response packages of Table 1 together with the broader corpus packages cited by persistent Figshare identifier (31943361, 31348411, 31348417), not an exclusive six-package closed set.
